She’s best for 337, but I think there are better options for 330. She herself admits that she’s still learning about digital marketing. I felt that her teaching style is quite bookish and not very practical. Her exams are also heavily based on the textbook, so you’ll need to study it thoroughly. Her grading is fair - you’ll get what you deserve. She might curve the grades if the overall section doesn’t perform well. For instance, she curved our section in 337, but not in 330.
For her report, there’s no need to worry about AI or plagiarism, because she checks everything manually during your presentation. You’ll need to be very fluent in English - I felt she focuses more on fluency and vocabulary than on the actual content during presentations.
Other than that, she’s very nice and friendly. She loves talking, and you’ll enjoy her stories. She also gives bonus assessments. For example, in 337, we had to write a short essay on a seminar we attended, and in 330, we did a role play.
